title: i'm making dating simulator game with ai npc using open source llm
author: aziib
selftext:
you can play on  your browser:  [https://romram.itch.io/break-time](https://romram.itch.io/break-time)  
you need LM Studio as a local server: [https://lmstudio.ai/](https://lmstudio.ai/)  
use uncensored llama 8b model or more and 8k context window or more for better experience.  
i use blacksheep gguf models:  
[https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/BlackSheep-RP-8B-i1-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/BlackSheep-RP-8B-i1-GGUF)  
[https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/BlackSheep-24B-i1-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/BlackSheep-24B-i1-GGUF) 

the game engine is using rpg maker mz with some of my modified custom plugins

comments.author: No-Zookeepergame8837
comments.body: Wow! I had the idea to do the exact same thing a year or so ago, but I had no idea there was a way to integrate APIs into RPGMaker, so I gave up! Can I ask how you managed to do it? I mean, is it an internet script, did you make it yourself, or is it some new built-in feature, or something?

comments.author: No-Rooster1109
comments.body: Cool project! I've been using Gylvessa for AI companionship and the conversations are pretty solid. Your setup looks way more technical than what I need though lol.
